serverInfo.title: Sanad
serverInfo.description: Read-only MCP server for Sanad — the voice-first WhatsApp AI receptionist for dental and aesthetics clinics in Dubai. Returns published pricing, overview and demo-booking guidance.

tools.name: get_service_boundaries
tools.description: What Sanad refuses to do and how clinical questions are routed.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Submit a clinic's own business contact details to request a demo. Human-confirmed, validated, idempotent, rate limited. Rejects patient data.

authentication.note: All tools are public. request_demo requires confirmed:true and an idempotency key, not a credential.

privacy.note: Five tools are read-only. request_demo transmits the clinic business contact details supplied by the caller to Netlify Forms. Patient data is rejected by design and never accepted.
